data.display_address: Trevino Residences, Jumeirah Village Triangle, Dubai
data.long_description:
Trevino by Avelon Developments redefines boutique living in Dubai. The cascading architecture combines contemporary design with natural elements, giving the complex a unique, dynamic aesthetic that stands out in JVC.

Inside, residences are crafted with elegance and comfort in mind. Large windows invite natural light to highlight the refined interiors, while thoughtful layouts ensure every space is functional yet inspiring.

The lifestyle amenities elevate everyday living. Lounge by the resort-style pool, enjoy the rooftop infinity pool, unwind in the meditation area, or host friends in the stylish barbecue and garden spaces designed for both relaxation and entertainment.
